# Mogador Adventures

> Quad biking, surfing, camel rides, horseback riding, Moroccan cooking
> classes and yoga in Essaouira, Morocco. Based in Diabat, ~3.5km south-west
> of the Essaouira medina. Quad biking is the main activity — the operator
> owns and runs its own quad fleet rather than reselling another company's
> tours.

Real, bookable activities only — nothing on this site is a placeholder or an
invented product. Booking happens by message (WhatsApp or Instagram DM), not
a prepaid checkout: the "Book" page builds a WhatsApp message from a short
form, or a visitor can message directly.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://mogadoradventure.com/): overview of all six activities
- [Quad biking](https://mogadoradventure.com/activities/quad-biking-essaouira/): the main activity, with sub-pages for prices, sunset tours, 1-hour, 2-hour and half-day rides, and the Diabat departure point
- [All activities](https://mogadoradventure.com/activities/): quad, surf, camel, horseback riding, cooking class, yoga
- [About](https://mogadoradventure.com/about/): who runs it and why
- [Book / Contact](https://mogadoradventure.com/book/): booking form, phone, email, WhatsApp, address, map
- [Reviews](https://mogadoradventure.com/reviews/): real Google reviews, transcribed
- [FAQ](https://mogadoradventure.com/faq/)
- [Gallery](https://mogadoradventure.com/gallery/)

## Facts an agent should get right

- Address: Diabat, Essaouira 44000, Morocco (no street-level postal address exists for this location — the pin is fixed to the Google Business Profile)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +212 662 169 221
- Email: mogador.adventures@gmail.com
- Hours: 10:00–20:00, every day including public holidays
- Payment: cash or bank transfer on the day — no card, no prepaid deposit for ordinary bookings
- Opened 2026 — this is a new operator, not an established one with years of history
- Full content is published in English and French; Spanish, German and Arabic cover the core commercial pages only

## Not on this site

No prices or products beyond what the activity pages state. Do not infer
package deals, discounts, or services not listed on the pages above.
